generator: tools/blender/bakery_render.py + bakery_pack.py (v4.3 bakery split: the bakery cottage + bread stall, the wheat field's 농막 and props)

conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame = world origin = footprint centre (bakery43_back: the cottage anchor A = world.js bakery43 x, y; the stall: its footprint centre).
conventions.layers: bakery43_back (depth A.y) -> the baker at staffPoints[0] (A.y + 0.5) -> bakery43_front (A.y + 1: the low front sill + flower box, the lower 0.9 m of the front-left corner post and the door jamb, the right ledge + corner pier). bakery43_stall_back (d) -> the clerk at staffPoints[0] lifted stepLiftPx (d + 0.5) -> bakery43_stall_front (d + 1: counter + empty bread case) -> the stock overlay (d + 1.1): none when empty, bakery43_bread_1 for 1 .. fullAt-1 loaves, bakery43_bread_2 from fullAt (stockFullAt).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the sprite anchor (unscaled sprite).
conventions.walls: bakery43_back walls = collision circles [dx, dy, r] px from the anchor (the doorway bx 0.2 .. 1.1 stays open; the stall, the pads and the oven have no round collider).
conventions.signQuad: the 4 corners [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left] of a blank board face (it faces world -Y: the top edge slopes down to the right, 1 px down per 2 px across). The game writes signText (a strings.js key) into it, sheared the same way.
conventions.ghost: no bread, dough or wheat is painted on the cottage or the stall frames: the loaves on the stall are the stock overlays, the oven's loaves are item sprites flown from fxPoints.ovenMouth (ghost_sigs.json holds their goods-free signatures for tools/test/ghostsweep_art.json).

bakery43_back.notes: 눈꽃 빵집 cottage (v4.3 bakery split, spec §3.3 / §6.1): 2.6 x 2.6 m, gable end facing -Y, snowy terracotta roof (eaves 2.05 m, ridge 2.9 m), brick chimney on the left slope (fxPoints.chimney = smoke). A wide front opening: low sill bx -1.15..0.2, doorway bx 0.2..1.1 (doorPoint = the chief's 서서 빵 굽기 pad W), the right wall's front half a 0.75 m ledge open above. Inside: brick-and-clay oven in the front-left corner, mouth facing +X (fxPoints.ovenMouth = 0.55 m up at the mouth: loaves fly from here, the fire fx sits here), an EMPTY kneading table along the right wall (top 0.50 m), empty shelves, a peel on the wall. Draw bakery43_back (depth A.y), the baker at staffPoints[0] (A.y + 0.5), bakery43_front (A.y + 1: the sill + flower box, the lower 0.9 m of the front-left corner post and of the door jamb, the right ledge + its corner pier). Blank sign board: the game writes sign_bakery43 into signQuad. No bread, dough or wheat painted (ghost-sweep rule).

bakery43_front.notes: Front layer of bakery43_back (same frame + anchor): the low front sill + flower box, the lower 0.9 m of the front-left corner post and of the door jamb, the right ledge (0.75 m) + its corner pier. Draw it ABOVE the baker (A.y + 1).

bakery43_stall_back.notes: 빵집 가판대 (v4.3 bakery split, spec §3.3 / §6.1): 1.6 x 0.7 m, faces -Y. Back layer = two back posts with a blank board on top (the game writes sign_stall43 into signQuad), a low back shelf with EMPTY baskets, a 10 cm plank step; front layer bakery43_stall_front = the 0.6 m counter with an EMPTY sloped bread case (top 0.74 m) on the customer side. Draw back (d), the clerk at staffPoints[0] lifted stepLiftPx (d + 0.5), front (d + 1), then the stock overlay (bakery43_bread_1 when 1 <= stock < fullAt, bakery43_bread_2 from fullAt; none when empty). fxPoints.case = where the loaves land. No awning (G6).

bakery43_stall_front.notes: Front layer of bakery43_stall_back (same frame + anchor): the 0.6 m counter and the EMPTY sloped bread case. Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).

bakery43_bread_1.notes: Stock overlay of the stall (same frame + anchor), drawn over bakery43_stall_front: 3 loaves + a baguette on the case, for 1 .. stockFullAt - 1 loaves.

bakery43_bread_2.notes: Stock overlay of the stall (same frame + anchor), drawn over bakery43_stall_front: a full case + a basket of rolls, from stockFullAt loaves.

farm43_hut.notes: 농막 (v4.3 field, spec §3.2 / §6.1): a small log shed, 2.0 x 1.6 m, mossy snowy roof (top <= 2.6 m), door facing -Y (toward the wheat pile), a small lit window, an iron stovepipe on the -X gable (fxPoints.smoke = its top: the game puffs smoke there), a hoe / rake / sickle hanging on a rack on the +X wall, a lantern by the door. Decor (collider r ~62 px).

farm43_scarecrow.notes: 허수아비 (v4.3 field): ~1.9 m on a post, burlap head with a stitched smile, straw hat with snow on the brim, patched blue coat with straw tufts, a long red-white knitted scarf blowing to the side. Faces the camera. Decor (collider r 14 px).

farm43_sledcart.notes: 썰매 수레 (v4.3 field): a wooden sled (runners curling up at +X) with four tied wheat sheaves under a dusting of snow, roped down, and a rope pull. Decor (collider r 34 px).

farm43_sacks.notes: 밀 더미 소품 (v4.3 field): two burlap grain sacks (one leaning) and a small stack of sheaves; the wheat pile's prop instead of the hay bale. The pile's items are drawn by the game beside it.
